incident: Pizza Rando community approvals did not reach the live feed
causes: Approval reused social scraper freshness checks even for manually approved community offers
A blocked approval dropped its queue row
Dispatch deduplication merged already-posted rows and lost newer Slack timestamps
Community heading could replace the deal title during fallback parsing
changes: Allow missing post dates only for human-approved community submissions with an explicit active calendar window
Yearless numeric dates require a submission no older than 14 days, a current human review, and dates within 60 days of submission; disjoint dates, ambiguous and invalid periods remain blocked
Preserve both adjacent offer days through subsequent normalization; record review provenance without inventing a source publication date
Retain blocked candidates for editing; send/update one Slack explanation per failure state
Keep each posted Slack message addressable and deduplicate community offers before posting
Recover orphaned community rows only from a recorded bot message plus its original community source record
Already-published targeted retries leave the feed unchanged

realSourceReadOnly.basis: Existing submitted text and human Slack approval; HTTP 200 is not independent offer confirmation

productionRecovery: After deployment, rerun only the target approval with the actual existing Slack reaction. Verify Pages and the public feed before claiming live.
